registration.received.in_app_message: Your registration request {{registration_reference}} has been received and is awaiting review. No action is required at this time.
registration.received.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing to confirm that your registration request has been received by the Authority and recorded under reference {{registration_reference}}.

Your request will be reviewed to confirm that the particulars and supporting documents provided are complete and consistent with the Authority's requirements. Should anything further be required, we will contact you with a formal request.

No action is required from you at this time. Please quote {{registration_reference}} in any communication with the Authority concerning this request.

What happens next
Once the review is concluded you will be notified of the outcome, or of any further information required, by email and through the portal.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.action_taken.in_app_message: {{reviewer_name}} recorded the action "{{action_name}}" on registration {{registration_reference}} at the {{step_name}} stage.{{#reviewer_comments}} Remarks: {{reviewer_comments}}{{/reviewer_comments}}

registration.comment_saved.in_app_message: A reviewer has recorded a remark on registration {{registration_reference}}. Please sign in to review it.
registration.comment_saved.email_body:
We are writing regarding your registration request {{registration_reference}}, which is currently under review by the Authority.

A remark has been recorded on the registration file by {{reviewer_name}} in the course of that review.

Remark
{{comments}}

Action required
Please sign in to the portal to review the remark in full and to provide any clarification requested.

What happens next
The Authority will continue its review once any clarification requested has been received.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.more_info_requested.in_app_message: Additional information is required to continue the review of registration {{registration_reference}}. Please sign in to respond.
registration.more_info_requested.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing regarding your registration request {{registration_reference}}, which is currently under review by the Authority.

As part of that review, additional information is required before the request can be progressed.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Information required
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal and provide the information and supporting documents requested{{#reviewer_name}}, as set out by {{reviewer_name}}{{/reviewer_name}}.

What happens next
Once your response is received, the Authority will continue its review of your registration request.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.correction_required.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} requires correction before it can proceed. Please sign in, address the matters raised and resubmit.
registration.correction_required.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing regarding your registration request {{registration_reference}}.

The request cannot proceed in its current form. It has been made available to you again so that the matters identified during review may be corrected.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Matters to be corrected
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal, correct each of the matters identified and resubmit the registration request together with any revised supporting documents.

What happens next
Review of your registration request will resume once a corrected submission has been received.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.returned_for_correction.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} has been returned to you for correction at the {{step_name}} stage. Please review the remarks and resubmit.
registration.returned_for_correction.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing regarding your registration request {{registration_reference}}, which has been considered by the Authority at the {{step_name}} stage.

The request has been returned to you so that the matters identified during review may be addressed.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Matters to be addressed
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal, address each of the matters identified{{#reviewer_name}} raised by {{reviewer_name}}{{/reviewer_name}}, and resubmit the registration request.

What happens next
Once your resubmission is received, the review will resume from the stage at which the request was returned.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.resubmission_requested.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} requires resubmission. Please review the matters raised and resubmit through the portal.
registration.resubmission_requested.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing regarding your registration request {{registration_reference}}.

Following review, the request cannot be determined in its current form and a resubmission is required.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Matters to be addressed
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal, revise the registration request to address each matter identified{{#reviewer_name}} by {{reviewer_name}}{{/reviewer_name}}, and resubmit it with any further documents required.

What happens next
The Authority will resume its review once a complete resubmission has been received.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.send_back.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} has been returned at the {{step_name}} stage for further action. Please sign in to review the remarks recorded.
registration.send_back.email_body:
We are writing regarding registration request {{registration_reference}}, which has been returned at the {{step_name}} stage{{#reviewer_name}} by {{reviewer_name}}{{/reviewer_name}}.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Remarks recorded
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal to review the remarks recorded and to take the action indicated.

What happens next
The review of the registration request will continue once the matters identified have been addressed.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.rejected.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} has not been approved. Please sign in to review the reasons recorded by the Authority.
registration.rejected.email_body:
We are writing regarding registration request {{registration_reference}}.

The Authority has completed its review of the request. Following that review, the registration request has not been approved.

{{#comments}}Reasons recorded by the Authority
{{comments}}

{{/comments}}Action required
Please sign in to the portal to review the outcome in full. No further action is required in respect of this request unless you wish to submit a fresh request.

What happens next
A new registration request may be submitted once the matters that led to this outcome have been addressed.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.final_rejected.in_app_message: The Authority has concluded its review of registration {{registration_reference}}. The request has not been approved. Please sign in to review the reasons recorded.
registration.final_rejected.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are writing regarding registration request {{registration_reference}}.

The Authority has concluded its review of the request and the registration has not been approved.

{{#reviewer_comments}}Reasons recorded by the Authority
{{reviewer_comments}}

{{/reviewer_comments}}Action required
No action is required from you in respect of this request. You may submit a fresh registration request once the matters recorded above have been addressed.

What happens next
Where you consider that the outcome should be reconsidered, please contact the Authority quoting reference {{registration_reference}}.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.approved.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} has been approved. You may now sign in to the portal to continue.
registration.approved.email_body:
Dear {{applicant_name}},

We are pleased to confirm that your registration request {{registration_reference}} has been approved by the Authority.

Your portal account is now active. You may sign in using the email address provided during registration. Where a temporary password was issued to you, you will be required to set a new password when you first sign in.

Action required
Please sign in to the Regulatory Portal to complete your profile and to proceed with the regulatory service you require.

{{#login_url}}Sign in at: {{login_url}}

{{/login_url}}What happens next
From the portal you can submit applications, respond to requests from the Authority, file regulatory returns where applicable and track the progress of each matter under its reference number.

Regards,
{{app_name}}

registration.final_approved.in_app_message: Registration {{registration_reference}} has been approved and your portal access is now active. Please sign in to continue.
